name: Band Pushup
cardText:
Band Pushup
Intermediate
1
Loop the band around your mid-back. The ends of the bands should be around your hands between your thumb and pointer finger.
2
This exercise can be done from the knees or the toes depending on experience level.
3
Begin by breaking at the elbows until your upper arm is by your side. Then extend at the elbows back into the top position.

name: Band Skullcrusher
cardText:
Band Skullcrusher
Advanced
1
Anchor a band to a stable point.
2
Face away and begin with your elbows bent and fists by your temples.
3
Extend your elbows until your triceps contract.

name: Band Overhead Tricep Extension
cardText:
Band Overhead Tricep Extension
Advanced
1
Stand with one or both feet on band. Go up and over your head with the band to the starting position.
2
Flex and extend your elbows.

name: Mini Band Tricep Pushdown
cardText:
Mini Band Tricep Pushdown
Novice
1
Loop band around wrists.
2
Keep one hand at shoulder height and press your other hand down.

name: Band Overhead Press
cardText:
Band Overhead Press
Novice
1
Stand between the two anchored bands, grasp them with an overhand grip, and position the bands at shoulder level.
2
Brace your core and push the bands overhead, fully extending your arms.
3
Lower the bands back to shoulder level, keeping your core engaged and arms straight. Repeat for desired number of reps.

name: Band Rapunzel Pushdown
cardText:
Band Rapunzel Pushdown
Beginner
1
Anchor the band to a high point and face away. Hold the band with both hands, placing your hands shoulder-width apart and keeping your elbows close to your body.
2
Slowly extend your arms downward, keeping your elbows close to your body. Push the band down as far as you can, feeling the contraction in your triceps.

name: Band Single Arm Pushdown
cardText:
Band Single Arm Pushdown
Novice
1
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with your right hand, with your arm at your side.
2
Flex and extend your elbow.

name: Single Arm Rapunzel Pushdown
cardText:
Single Arm Rapunzel Pushdown
Beginner
1
Stand with a band anchored to a high point. Face away from the band. Hold the loop in one hand.
2
Keep your elbow tucked in to your side. Extend your elbow. When you extend, don't let your upper arm raise. The band should land over your shoulder.

name: Band Standing Chest Press
cardText:
Band Standing Chest Press
Beginner
1
Loop the band around your back. The two end loops in each of your hands.
2
Extend your shoulder joint and elbow across your body until your arm is fully extended.

name: Band Tricep Kickback
cardText:
Band Tricep Kickback
Beginner
1
Anchor the band to a stable point.
2
Hinge forward. Extend and flex at the elbow.

name: Band Floor Press
cardText:
Band Floor Press
Beginner
1
Lie on your back holding band loops with elbows resting on the floor.
2
Press arms straight up until elbows extend without locking.
3
Lower elbows back to floor under control, keeping tension throughout.
